theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → n ≤ P → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → IsConeCurrent S → (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) → R.Represents S → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ v ∈ L, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v) → ∃ (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)), R₀.Represents S₀ ∧ IsMinimizingIn S₀ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ BoundaryVanishes S₀ ∧ IsConeCurrent S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]
